title: Office Attacks!
description:
Between my 2nd and 3rd years of college, I worked a summer at Arctic Empire, helping them build their mobile tower defense game, Office Attacks! In this game you'd collect and combine pieces to build unique towers, then defend yourself against waves of co-workers.

![](/assets/projects/career/office-attacks/screenshot-9.webp)

I was initially brought on to build minigames but when that went well, I helped build the main game and optimize its rendering.

![](/assets/projects/career/office-attacks/screenshot-11.webp)![](/assets/projects/career/office-attacks/screenshot-10.webp)

The game had such a huge volume of characters and tower parts, that using standard spritesheets for them all would've made the build massive, so we wrote a custom SVG renderer that could take the raw assets from our artist and draw them directly, animations and all.
